name: generate-qr
description: Requires Node.js 22+ and npm registry access to run the pinned @qrdx/cli; no account or API key. Generate styled, scannable QR codes from URLs, text, Wi-Fi logins or vCards as SVG, PNG, WebP or EPS, or one per CSV row, with gradients, dot and eye patterns, frames, templates and a center logo.
